proposal.rationale: Rejected students only get the reason inside the message text. Enrollment already stores the machine-readable reason (enrollment.types.ts Enrollment.reason; enrollment.service.ts enroll()), but Notification (notification.types.ts) has no such field, so the web page cannot show it. Add a nullable reason attribute to the Notification data, set only on enrollment-rejected notifications, and describe the web page showing it. Left unchanged on purpose: Enrollment data, seat-limit rule, module dependencies (mod-notifications stays dependency-free, so the reason is typed string there like Enrollment.reason, not a reference), no events/contracts, confirmed enrollments and their notifications, capabilities, and the message texts.

operations.summary: add attribute att-ntf-reason (reason: string) to dat-notification
change the statement of rule rul-announce-every-decision

implementation.behavior: When an enrollment is rejected, the notification created for the student carries the rejection reason (COURSE_FULL or ALREADY_ENROLLED) in a new optional `reason` field, returned by GET /notifications, and the web page shows that reason next to the rejected notification. Confirmed notifications have no reason.
acceptanceCriteria: A COURSE_FULL rejection produces a notification with reason COURSE_FULL, and the message text is unchanged
An ALREADY_ENROLLED rejection produces a notification with reason ALREADY_ENROLLED
A confirmed enrollment's notification has no reason field and is otherwise unchanged
GET /api/notifications returns the reason for rejected notifications
The web page shows the reason next to a rejected notification and nothing extra for confirmed ones
The notifications module does not import from the enrollment module (no new module dependency)
suggestedTests: EnrollmentService: rejects an enrollment into a full course and notifies the student
NotificationsService: keeps each recipient's notifications separate, in order
App: shows the outcome and the student's notification after enrolling, then a rejection when full

changes.name: Enroll and see outcome via the page

fields.before: App.tsx: submit the form, show outcome, then reload that student's notifications and the course seat counts.
fields.after: App.tsx: submit the form, show outcome, then reload that student's notifications and the course seat counts. A rejected notification is shown with its rejection reason next to it.

fields.before: notification.types.ts, in-memory outbox; ids ntf-N. kind is enrollment-confirmed|enrollment-rejected. enrollmentId points at an Enrollment in another module, so it is typed id rather than reference.
fields.after: notification.types.ts, in-memory outbox; ids ntf-N. kind is enrollment-confirmed|enrollment-rejected. reason is COURSE_FULL|ALREADY_ENROLLED, set only on enrollment-rejected notifications and absent on confirmed ones; it duplicates the rejected Enrollment's reason as its own field in addition to the…

fields.before: Each enrollment decision, confirmed or rejected, is recorded and results in exactly one notification to the student.
fields.after: Each enrollment decision, confirmed or rejected, is recorded and results in exactly one notification to the student. A rejection notification also carries the rejection reason (COURSE_FULL or ALREADY_ENROLLED) as its own field.
